outcome: Growth differentiation factor 15 (GDF15) levels in cerebrospinal fluid and serum
Homeostatic model assessment for beta-cell function
finding: Growth differentiation factor 15 (GDF15) levels were elevated in both cerebrospinal fluid and serum during pregnancy compared to 5 years postpartum, were highest in women carrying a female fetus, and correlated with markers of glucose metabolism and placental weight.
